name: Golden Dataset 1: Regression-Introducing PRs
objective: Select 12 regression-introducing merged PRs per repository, split into 4 Easy, 4 Medium, and 4 Hard candidates. Within each bucket, prefer PRs that introduced the largest number of known closed issues with direct GitHub evidence; where multi-issue candidates are scarce, use the strongest single-issue attributions.
evidence_policy: A known issue is counted only when the issue body, a GitHub issue comment, or a linked PR/timeline discussion explicitly connects the issue to the introducing PR. Closed PRs are not counted as issues.

excluded_near_misses.reason: Appeared as a two-issue raw group, but it was an issue number being referenced by related work, not a merged introducing PR with multiple caused issues.

verification_notes: Every counted issue above was checked via GitHub API as state=closed and is_pr=false.
Every introducing PR above was checked via GitHub API as merged=true.
PR complexity metadata was checked from GitHub PR file stats.
The final dataset lists exactly 12 PRs for manaflow-ai/cmux and exactly 12 PRs for calcom/cal.diy, with 4 Easy, 4 Medium, and 4 Hard entries per repository.
The expansion added 6 PRs per repository on 2026-06-16 using the same explicit attribution policy as the original pass.
